requirement.statement: cozo-wiki SHALL provide a local server mode through `--serve` that exposes LLM wiki repo DB tools over HTTP for the visualization frontend.

case.then: The server SHALL bind to localhost by default and expose `GET /health`

case.given: A user passes existing storage options
case.then: The server SHALL use the same sqlite layout as MCP and CLI modes

requirement.statement: The server SHALL expose typed repo knowledge endpoints and a generic tool bridge backed by the shared LLM wiki tool runner.

case.then: The response SHALL include the same tool metadata exposed by MCP tools/list
The server SHALL call the shared `semantic_search` tool
